bio.text: Kelly Seyarto, a Republican, represents the 32nd Senate District in the California State Senate.
His official website says he was elected in 2022 and previously served in the 67th Assembly District from 2020 to 2022.

According to the same page, he is a retired firefighter whose career ended with his retirement as a Battalion Chief from the Los Angeles County Fire Department in 2015, served on the Murrieta City Council, and holds degrees from Mt. San Antonio College, CSU Los Angeles and CSU Long Beach.
